tweets.text:
Token unlocks don’t always dump price, but ignoring them completely is how you end up holding supply that someone else has been waiting months to sell.

Always know what’s coming before you size in. Especially on long term holds.

This doesn't mean you should always stay away from projects that are still unlocking tokens, but make sure there's some good momentum or some form of buyback in place to offset those unlocks.

No momentum in the market + Big unlocks is eternal bleed lower. This has been the case for almost every coin that launched over the past few years.

$BTC Trading back into the range and testing the 4H 200MA.

Still a lot of equal highs around $84K where a good amount of short interest entered after the hot CPI print last week.

quote.text:
$BTC Loves following this pattern. During 2023-2025 we saw the same during the entire run up.

1. Volatility low, compression high, sentiment worsens
2. Sweep local lows (sometimes several times)
3. Retake previous low
4. Quick move towards top of range
5. Big move outside of range into new highs

Yet, during every consolidation, calls for a top happen and people willingly sell their coins. The easiest thing to not have this happen to you is to wait for candle closes and to see if a "break" below sees any follow through.

As you can see in these cases we had a few small breakdowns and price action below the initial support levels. Yet, there was never any considerable follow through lower. This means a lot of absorption is taking place.

Then when price recovers, sellers are mostly out and it flies with added short fuel too.

In today's case, $83K is a good first level for the daily closes to watch. From there, if bullish, you'd want to see quick acceleration to $87K+ without too much hesitation. Generally this takes less than a few days if the past 2 cases are of any indication.

tweets.text:
I sent ChatGPT the full series of $TIBBIR tweets, the bridge lore, the Robinhood move, the RWA statement, and now these new “Principles.”

Its read was interesting:

This doesn’t feel like another teaser.

It feels like TIBBIR defining what it wants to become.

The sequence has basically been:

cryptic Ribbita
→ bridge
→ Robinhood Chain
→ “ $TIBBIR was built for real world assets”
→ silence
→ now a set of principles around better money, trust, conviction, compounding and culture.

The biggest thing ChatGPT pointed out is the language.
Before, Ribbita mostly spoke like a character.
Now it’s suddenly:
“We believe…”
“We question…”
“We preserve…”
“Our work…”
That sounds a lot more like an organisation defining its identity.

And the first principle : “Better money, better life” is especially interesting considering how closely that overlaps with Micky Malka/Ribbit’s own philosophy around financial freedom and better money.

None of this confirms anything by itself.

But it does make the Robinhood bridge feel less like the end of the story and more like the point where $TIBBIR moved to its intended home before showing what comes next.

The puzzles told us where it was going.
The principles might be telling us what it wants to build once it gets there.

quote.text:
I sent ChatGPT the full series of $TIBBIR tweets, the bridge lore, the Robinhood move, the RWA statement, and now these new “Principles.”

Its read was interesting:

This doesn’t feel like another teaser.

It feels like TIBBIR defining what it wants to become.

The sequence has basically been:

cryptic Ribbita
→ bridge
→ Robinhood Chain
→ “ $TIBBIR was built for real world assets”
→ silence
→ now a set of principles around better money, trust, conviction, compounding and culture.

The biggest thing ChatGPT pointed out is the language.
Before, Ribbita mostly spoke like a character.
Now it’s suddenly:
“We believe…”
“We question…”
“We preserve…”
“Our work…”
That sounds a lot more like an organisation defining its identity.

And the first principle : “Better money, better life” is especially interesting considering how closely that overlaps with Micky Malka/Ribbit’s own philosophy around financial freedom and better money.

None of this confirms anything by itself.

But it does make the Robinhood bridge feel less like the end of the story and more like the point where $TIBBIR moved to its intended home before showing what comes next.

The puzzles told us where it was going.
The principles might be telling us what it wants to build once it gets there.

quote.text:
$BTC Loves following this pattern. During 2023-2025 we saw the same during the entire run up.

1. Volatility low, compression high, sentiment worsens
2. Sweep local lows (sometimes several times)
3. Retake previous low
4. Quick move towards top of range
5. Big move outside of range into new highs

Yet, during every consolidation, calls for a top happen and people willingly sell their coins. The easiest thing to not have this happen to you is to wait for candle closes and to see if a "break" below sees any follow through.

As you can see in these cases we had a few small breakdowns and price action below the initial support levels. Yet, there was never any considerable follow through lower. This means a lot of absorption is taking place.

Then when price recovers, sellers are mostly out and it flies with added short fuel too.

In today's case, $83K is a good first level for the daily closes to watch. From there, if bullish, you'd want to see quick acceleration to $87K+ without too much hesitation. Generally this takes less than a few days if the past 2 cases are of any indication.
